name: SubWerk
author: Devko
summary: Analog-style monosynth in the spirit of a 37-key American paraphonic classic: two morphing oscillators with hard sync, sub and noise, a feedback mixer, a 4-pole ladder filter with Multidrive, two looping envelopes, glide and Duo. 57 presets and a six-tab touchscreen skin with Q-Links.
